title: Apartheid institutionalized in South Africa
description: Racial segregation and discrimination become formal state policy; political rights denied to the majority.

title: Resistance and international pressure
description:
Mass movements, underground organizations and global condemnation challenge apartheid.
	Leaders like Nelson Mandela become symbols of the struggle.

title: Unbanning and negotiations begin
description: Political bans are lifted; negotiations open for a new democratic order and constitutional framework.

title: First democratic elections in South Africa
description: Universal adult franchise; apartheid ends in practice; a new government forms with a mandate for constitutional change.

title: South African Constitution adopted
description:
A modern constitution emphasizes equality, rights, and democratic institutions.
	Design choices aim to prevent future oppression and ensure accountability.

title: India's Constituent Assembly debates
description: Representatives discuss principles, rights, federalism, and institutions to govern a diverse country.

title: Constitution of India comes into effect
description: India becomes a republic with universal adult franchise, fundamental rights, and parliamentary democracy.

title: Constitutional design as ongoing practice
description:
Constitutions shape democratic life by: limiting government power, protecting rights, enabling participation, and creating institutions (legislature, executive, judiciary).
	Design balances majority rule with minority protection.
